title: "error: unrecognized arguments: --ros-args" from argparse in ROS 2: ros2 launch, ros2 run, parse_known_args, remove_ros_args and UnknownROSArgsError, measured
excerpt: Why ros2 launch kills a Python node that uses argparse: launch adds --ros-args to every Node. Measured fixes on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical: remove_ros_args, parse_known_args and its two traps, argument order, rclpy.init with the full argv, and rclcpp init_and_remove_ros_arguments.
